## Activation gate

This new workflow is intentionally inactive until all three values are configured:

1. Replace `REPLACE_WITH_SHARED_SECRET` in **Validate + Prepare**.
2. Replace `REPLACE_WITH_GMAIL_ADDRESS` in **Send Gmail via SMTP**.
3. Connect an SMTP credential using `smtp.gmail.com`, port `465`, SSL/TLS, the Gmail address, and a Google App Password.

Enter the App Password directly in n8n; never put it in source code or chat.

Do not reuse or modify either existing Watch workflow.
